boundary_statement: The publish step in step 5 is performed by the host. It reproduces what the game does, but it is not a recovery of the game's own publish code, which the static search showed does not exist in the three modules as a store to that slot.
still_uncertain: the meaning of the last three strings
whether Options::LoadDefaults succeeds with no configuration present
whether SoundManager::Initialize tolerates a dummy string
whether the device needs shader data beyond what Direct3D11.dll embeds
why_this_is_the_right_stopping_point: Every entry point, object size, argument mapping, call order and file dependency has been established from static reading, and the two former blockers (endless publisher hunt, feared disk dependencies) are both resolved to no-ops for a host. What remains can only be settled by running it, which is outside this goal's static constraint.
